children: As the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX returns to the iconic Las Vegas Strip in 2026,

is once again putting guests at the center of the action with race week festivities, luxury accommodations, superstar culinary experiences and exclusive viewing opportunities. From the company's collection of eight resorts, all located within the track footprint, Caesars is delivering immersive experiences designed to bring guests closer than ever to the thrill of the race.

"We're thrilled to welcome the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX back to the heart of The Strip," said Sean McBurney, Chief Commercial Officer and Regional President for Caesars Entertainment. "This year, we're raising the bar with dynamic viewing experiences across the city, an ultra-exclusive party at Soleia Beach Club atop the newly opened Vanderpump Hotel for select Caesars Rewards members where guests can mingle with Buddy V, Lisa Vanderpump and more, and intimate culinary experiences curated by our celebrity chef partners. World-class racing deserves world-class hospitality, and no city delivers that like Las Vegas."
GIADA Viewing Experience at The Vanderpump Hotel

Guests can take in the race action from GIADA alongside celebrity chef and television personality Giada De Laurentiis (Saturday only). Located in the heart of The Strip at The Vanderpump Hotel, fans will enjoy elevated hospitality and all-inclusive food and drinks. The experience will feature Strip views from the open-air restaurant overlooking the main straight. When not watching from the open windows, guests can take in the live race feed on TVs around the venue while indulging in cocktails and bites.
Two-day Package (Thursday and Friday): $550 per person
Two-day Package (Friday and Saturday): $1,050 per person
Caramella Terrace Viewing Experience at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino

Experience race weekend from the terrace and hidden lounge at Caramella. Guests will enjoy all-inclusive cocktails, chef-curated cuisine, premium views of the main straight, exclusive hidden terrace access and live DJ sets that will keep the party going all weekend long. When not watching from the terrace edge, guests will take in the live race feed on TVs throughout the space. More than just a race, enjoy interactive F1-themed activations, including a race simulator experience, entertainment and immersive experiences that bring the excitement of the Las Vegas Grand Prix to life beyond the track.
Two-day Package (Friday and Saturday): $850 per person
Gordon Ramsay HELL’S KITCHEN Trackside Lunch with Gordon Ramsay at Caesars Palace

Returning for 2026 following three sold-out events in 2023, 2024 and 2025, guests will once again enjoy a specially curated four-course menu by Chef Ramsay at his famed Strip-side restaurant. Ticketed guests will hear from Gordon Ramsay directly as he makes a special appearance to discuss his love of food and racing.
$299 per person; beverage package available for $99
*New for 2026: Cocktail Reception with Martha Stewart at The Bedford at Paris Las Vegas

Guests are invited to an exclusive cocktail reception with entrepreneur and global lifestyle icon Martha Stewart for drinks and light bites inspired by The Bedford’s new Afternoon Tea menu, including caviar and Champagne, along with a special cocktail demonstration by Martha. Each guest will also receive a signed cookbook as part of the experience.
with Chef Rick Bayless and Barcelona’s SIPS Drinkery House

Join James Beard Award-winning chef Rick Bayless and Barcelona’s SIPS, named The World’s Best Bar by The World’s 50 Best Bars 2023, as they bring together the culinary traditions of Spain and Mexico for an exclusive race week experience. Chef Rick Bayless will lead a moderated discussion with the SIPS Barcelona team on how Spain’s flavors have influenced Mexico’s food. Guests will experience curated SIPS cocktails with food offerings from the celebrated chef while learning more about the regions and cultures. Additionally, guests will enjoy a meet-and-greet, cookbook signings and exclusive merchandise.
Dine with Chef Guy Savoy at Restaurant Guy Savoy at Caesars Palace

Guests who dine at MICHELIN-starred Restaurant Guy Savoy over race weekend will have the pleasure of seeing the master in action. Internationally renowned Chef Guy Savoy and his award-winning culinary team will delight guests with an elevated French dining experience built around exceptional ingredients, thoughtful preparation and impeccable service. As the restaurant commemorates its 20th anniversary, it continues to stand among the world's most celebrated dining destinations. Additionally, race weekend guests will receive a personally signed memento from Chef Savoy as part of their special dining experience. For more information and to make a reservation, please visit
Please note that all ticket prices are subject to tax and include an 18% gratuity.
Caesars Entertainment is a proud Founding Partner of the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX. For more information and to book experiences, please visit caesars.com/events/f1.
What is Caesars Entertainment offering during race week?
Caesars Entertainment is offering exclusive race viewing experiences, celebrity chef events and special race week celebrations across its Las Vegas resorts within the circuit.
When is the FORMULA 1 HEINEKEN LAS VEGAS GRAND PRIX 2026?
The race weekend takes place Nov. 19-21, 2026, on the Las Vegas Strip.
Where can guests watch the race through Caesars Entertainment experiences?

Guests can enjoy viewing opportunities at GIADA at The Vanderpump Hotel and Caramella at Planet Hollywood Resort & Casino, both offering premium views of the circuit, food and beverage and live race coverage.
Which celebrity chefs are participating in race week events?
Featured culinary personalities include Gordon Ramsay, Martha Stewart, Guy Savoy, Giada De Laurentiis and Rick Bayless with SIPS.
Are food and beverage offerings included with viewing experiences?
Yes. Both the GIADA Viewing Experience and Caramella Terrace Viewing Experience include food and beverages as part of the ticket package.
Can I stay at a Caesars Entertainment resort and attend race events?
Yes. Guests can book hotel accommodations at any of Caesars Entertainment's eight Las Vegas resorts.
Do ticket prices include taxes and gratuity?
Yes. All listed event and viewing experience prices are subject to tax and include an 18% gratuity.
How can I book a race week experience?
Visit caesars.com/events/f1 or call 888-507-8881 for reservations and additional information.
What is the best way to stay updated on event details?
Guests should visit caesars.com/events/f1 for the latest event schedules, availability and updates.
